/scripts.value:
on PrepareClassSelectionDropdown
	local tDropDown
	repeat with x = 1 to the number of lines in ListOfClasses 
		put item 3 of line x of ListOfClasses & "||" & item 1 of line x of ListOfClasses & lf after tDropDown
	end repeat
	delete last character of tDropDown
	put tDropDown into ListOfClasses
end PrepareClassSelectionDropdown
